project_type: TypeScript pnpm monorepo - AWS CDK backend with React frontend
build_system: pnpm workspaces (pnpm-workspace.yaml covers packages/*, infra, lambdas/*, config). Each package has its own tsconfig.build.json. Root scripts: build, test, lint.
test_framework: vitest (3.1.4) - tests colocated as *.test.ts in src/. CDK assertions for infra (infra/test/main-stack.test.ts).
build_command: eval "$(mise activate bash)" && pnpm install && pnpm build
verification_instructions: 1. pnpm install 2. pnpm build (all packages compile) 3. pnpm test (all tests pass) 4. pnpm lint (no lint errors)
setup_instructions: mise install node@22 (MISE_NODE_VERIFY=false if GPG fails), mise use node@22, npm install -g pnpm@10, pnpm install
environment_constraints: COMMON_DEPENDENCIES network mode - npm registry accessible. No Docker daemon available - container builds must be validated via CDK assertions only. Node 22 via mise. Bun also available but project uses pnpm.
contribution_requirements: Monorepo conventions: @slide-first/ package prefix, workspace:* for internal deps, ESM modules (Node16 resolution), strict TypeScript, vitest for tests, eslint 9 flat config.
key_patterns: Lambdas follow single-handler pattern with colocated tests. CDK constructs in infra/lib/. Types in packages/shared-types. Core business logic in packages/core. Config in config/src/parameter.ts with EnvironmentConfig interface. API Lambda uses path-based routing via regex patterns. State machines use Step Functions Standard with callback token pattern for approvals.
directory_structure: Root: package.json, pnpm-workspace.yaml, tsconfig.json. packages/: shared-types, core, renderer-port, renderer-ffmpeg, renderer-hyperframes, renderer-contract-tests, evaluation. lambdas/: api, composition-builder, marp-render, polly-worker, render-worker, slide-generator. infra/: CDK app (bin/, lib/, src/, test/). config/: environment configs.
